closedFindings.finding: Focus verification compared only PID and bounds
closedFindings.resolution: Uses CFEqual against the retained AX element plus actual foreground application and bounds

closedFindings.finding: Partial multi-step actions lost side-effect state
closedFindings.resolution: WindowFailure returns acted/action_sent/outcome and available actual bounds

closedFindings.finding: Python IPC discarded native failure metadata
closedFindings.resolution: Typed _failure_details whitelist preserves side-effect and rollback state through the public MCP envelope

closedFindings.finding: Truncated AX enumeration could claim a unique binding
closedFindings.resolution: Rejects enumeration above 64 elements or beyond the deadline before binding
closedFindings.verification: Independent static review of frozen source

closedFindings.finding: Window handle and PID accepted booleans or fractional identities
closedFindings.resolution: Strict finite integral identity validation before mutation

closedFindings.finding: One-shot helper lost AX identity when minimized windows disappeared from CG
closedFindings.resolution: One serialized worker retains private UUID references and AX identity, verifies current process start and CFEqual membership before restoring

closedFindings.finding: A minimized window could be reported closed despite refusing closure
closedFindings.resolution: Closure requires original AX element absence from the complete bounded application window list, a distinct process start or confirmed ESRCH

closedFindings.finding: Identity-change verification failure after an action lost side-effect metadata
closedFindings.resolution: Uses WindowFailure then invalidates the old reference
closedFindings.verification: Independent static review of frozen source

closedFindings.finding: Concurrent session shutdown could close descriptors while a request was reading
closedFindings.resolution: Public close serializes with the request lock and internal close avoids recursive locking

closedFindings.finding: Failed process identity lookup could be mistaken for confirmed process exit
closedFindings.resolution: Nil identity is considered closed only when kill(pid,0) confirms ESRCH
closedFindings.verification: Independent static review of frozen source
